# U53: Workspace is one place: the switcher at the top switches as a page move (Back returns, a check-in draft is warned about and kept), your role is said in one line, About names the admins, Feedback is beside Help, and a member leaves from Settings

- **Belongs to:** the Feedback module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `WORKSPACE-ONE-PLACE`, `FEEDBACK-PAGE`, `LEAVE-WORKSPACE`
- **Budget:** 45 steps, not scored: this journey’s ease test leaves `budget` out, so it may take more (the steps below are counted all the same)
- **Ease test:** every point but `budget`, `progress` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `/` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, line 4525

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- Go to `/` in the demo.
- _Note:_ A second workspace of Rhea's own in this browser, so there is something to switch to.
- _Note:_ Rhea isn't an admin: Workspace says so in one line, and About names the admins (WR2); her badge doesn't say Admin.
- Go to `/workspace` in the demo.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if a member’s line says “{role}”.
- If `!phone`:
  - **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if a member’s badge says Admin.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if About does not name the admins for a member, or shows a member what to sort out.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “member”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Part-way through a check-in, switching asks first and says the draft stays. (A phone's check-in takes the whole screen, with no switcher: there you switch from Home.)
- Go to `{phone ? '/' : '/check-in?start=1'}` in the demo.
- If `!phone`:
  - Type “7” into the “This week’s value” field.
- **Step.** Open the workspace switcher (the sidebar’s header on a computer, the top bar’s line on a phone).
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if the switcher does not say Rhea’s role on the open workspace.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Rhea’s own team” button in the Workspaces dialog is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- **Step.** Press the “Rhea’s own team” button in the Workspaces dialog.
- If `!phone`:
  - **Check:** The “Switch to Rhea’s own team” dialog shows.
  - **Check:** (`errors`) it fails if switching mid check-in does not say the draft is kept.
  - **Check:** Checkpoint “warned”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
  - **Step.** Press the “Switch workspace” button in the “Switch to Rhea’s own team” dialog.
- **Check:** The address changes.
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if switching did not land on the new workspace’s Home.
- _Note:_ Back returns to the example, at the check-in, with the draft still there.
- Press the browser’s Back.
- If `!phone`:
  - **Check:** The “This week’s value” field shows.
- **Check:** (`errors`) it fails if Back went to {new URL(p.url()).pathname} in {ws} with the draft “{kept}”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “back”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Feedback is its own page beside Help; the old inbox address leads there.
- Go to `/workspace/inbox` in the demo.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/feedback”.
- _Note:_ Wait for the page to draw: under a loaded machine the address changes a moment before the heading shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) it fails if the inbox’s old address does not open Feedback.
- If `!phone`:
  - **Check:** (`entry`) the “Feedback” link in the sidebar is visible (else: Feedback is not in the sidebar).
- _Note:_ Rhea leaves the example, from Settings (WR2): who takes over her goals first.
- Go to `/settings` in the demo.
- **Step.** Press the “Leave this workspace…” button.
- **Check:** The “Leave …Platform Engineering” dialog shows.
- **Step.** Press the “Leave the workspace” button in the “Leave …Platform Engineering” dialog.
- **Check:** “Choose who takes them over.” is shown in the “Leave …Platform Engineering” dialog (else: leaving without a handover is not explained).
- Find and pick: press “Who takes over your” in the “Leave …Platform Engineering” dialog, type “tariq”, and choose “Tariq Haddad”.
- If the “open asks” button in the “Leave …Platform Engineering” dialog is there:
  - Find and pick: press “open asks” in the “Leave …Platform Engineering” dialog, type “tariq”, and choose “Tariq Haddad”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “leave”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Leave the workspace” button in the “Leave …Platform Engineering” dialog.
- **Check:** “You’ve left” is shown (else: leaving is not confirmed).
- **Check:** (`logged`) it fails if leaving is not saved and logged with the goals handed over.
- _Note:_ An admin: Admin on her badge, every section, and Cycles with dates and what's running.
- Open a fresh browser as Grace (`grace`).
- Open a fresh browser as Grace (`grace`).
- Go to `/workspace/cycles` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Week 45 of 53” is shown (else: Cycles does not say which cycle is running).
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if Cycles has no dates, or an admin’s badge does not say Admin.
- Go to `/teams` in the demo.
- Press the team row (`.team-row`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/teams/cicd”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) it fails if a team row opens “{group}”, not its people.
- _Note:_ Set-up starts as the person you are, and asks about recording, off unless ticked.
- Go to `/workspace/new` in the demo.
- Press the “Change how you’ll work” button.
- **Check:** (`attention`) not (the “Record how the app is used here” tick box in the “How you’ll work” dialog is ticked) (else: recording is ticked at set-up before anyone chose it).
- Press the “Done” button in the “How you’ll work” dialog.
- Type “Grace’s test” into the “Workspace name” field.
- Press the “Change” button in the “Which one is you?” step of set-up.
- **Check:** (`attention`) it fails if set-up does not start as the person you are.
- Close this browser.
- Close this browser.
